question: In the five kingdom classification, bacteria are included in Kingdom:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Monera.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• **Bacteria is included in the Monera kingdom.**
 
• The Monera Kingdom is classified into three sub-kingdoms- Archaebacteria, Eubacteria, and Cyanobacteria.
 
• Blue-green algae are cyanobacteria. 
 
• They are found in the aquatic region.
 
• Characteristics of Monera-
 
 
• These are unicellular organisms.
 
• They reproduce asexually by binary fission or budding.
 
• It lacks organelles like mitochondria, lysosomes, plastids, Golgi bodies, endoplasmic reticulum, centrosome, etc.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The five-kingdom system was proposed by R.H. Whittaker (1969).
 
• The main criteria for classification used by him- 
 
 
• (1) Cell structure (2) Body organization (3) Mode of nutrition (4) Reproduction (5) Phylogenetic relationships.
 
 
 
• The kingdom defined by him was named -
 
 
• Monera- All the prokarytotes
 
• Protista- All the Unicellular eukaryotes
 
• Fungi- True fungi
 
• Plantae- All the multicellular plants
 
• Animalia- All the multicellular animals
